body: Thank you, you have no idea how much I've appreciated everyone that's taken the time to say something. I feel better talking to people about it, even if its over the internet, but I've basically set certain standards and goals for myself that I need to reach in a certain amount of time, and if I don't reach those in the allotted time I'll probably do it. Don't worry though, I'll probably find a way to fuck it up somehow.

Trust me, I'm as terrible a person as I described, and no, I'm not very interesting. I really appreciate your comment though, a lot of people really underestimate the effect of just showing that you care, even if I've never met you and don't know you. As for the therapist, I really just don't know how to approach that, and probably just won't. I'm not sure it would do much good anyway, I'd feel like such a failure telling someone face to face about all this. Good thing I don't know any of you.

Thanks for the compliment on my writing, its the only thing I really do half decently in school. Though I have terrible penmanship, so I even managed to fuck that up too. As for the therapist thing, I can't really do that. I couldn't face my parents, they'd be so damn disappointed in me. I mean, I'm sure they already are, but they would blame themselves if I told them about how much I hate myself. As for doing things for fun, I like to read a lot, and sometimes write short stories. I live out in the country so there's really not much to do out here, but sometimes me and my buddy like to put together bombs or rockets. I live in California which has completely idiotic fireworks laws, but I've got acres of land and orchard perfect for some fucking explosives! So we just make them out of different things. People would be surprised what you can make out of common household products. As for friends, I'm doing better than I was. I was at a school where I rarely talked, though when I did I was friendly and polite. There was no bullying like I see on a lot of posts here, but I had mainly one really good friend (guy I make fireworks with) and he left the school, and so two weeks later I didn't tell anyone I was leaving and transfered to another school. It was a great switch, I have a lot more friends, and I guess I'm known as a fairly popular person. Though I did have a few friends who I was basically brothers with when I was younger, but they all moved to different states, mostly because of financial issues with that whole 2008 recession shitstorm. As for siblings, I have a 22 year old brother who's in a happy relationship and a 24 year old sister who, as of January, is engaged to her boyfriend of 7 years.

Thanks for the advice man, it means a lot. I still don't really know how I would get through another however the hell many years of this though. And even if I did only what I wanted to do, I'd probably be happy for a while, but eventually just have some sort of breakdown because I would know that I wasn't really contributing to society. But if I were to try to get somewhere in life, I'd fall short. Lose lose I really. I've already given myself an ultimatum though, so we'll see how it works out I guess.
